suggested_solution.solution: Use a B550 motherboard with a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for future-proofing and optimal performance.
suggested_solution.description: This solution takes advantage of the latest PCI-E technology to provide the best possible performance for modern GPUs like the RTX 5060 and RX 5700X.

suggested_solution.solution: Use an A520 motherboard with a PCIe 3.0 x16 slot as a cost-effective alternative.
suggested_solution.description: This solution provides a more affordable option for users who want to play games at lower resolutions (e.g., 1080p) but are willing to sacrifice some performance.
